constraints: Single working directory /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela on main; no worktrees or branches; workers run no git write operations; serial finalization commits and pushes main (gitPush=true).

Each worker edits only its own writePaths, records pre/post shasum -a 256 per edit, re-applies intent on drift and never reverts a foreign change; out-of-scope compile errors are logged as outOfScope and the plan is marked blocked for a checkpoint amendment.

Every swift/swiftlint command runs in the foreground as arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc with output under tmp/crypto5-prevtick/<planId>/ and an exit status recorded; a filter matching 0 tests is a failure; blocked checks are never recorded as passes.
Package.resolved files are produced by SwiftPM only and owned solely by c5pt-01.
Blockers: upstream-crypto-cap, upstream-capability-removed and upstream-reader-catalog-missing-findChildPage are reported, never worked around.
Wave 2 Swift plans wait for c5pt-01 because every swift build/test compiles the whole package.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Previous tick is schedule-derived, not history-derived, so skipped, coalesced or missed ticks still define the window and the value is deterministic (design §2.1).

Bounded coarse-to-fine skip-scan with calendar.dateInterval jumps keeps the result exact against a per-second matches scan while staying DST-correct and cheap; 9-year horizon covers the Feb 29 gap (design §2.2).
matches and previousOccurrence share per-field predicate helpers so the dom/dow OR rule is not reimplemented (design §2.2).
Only dispatchCronTick builds the envelope; read-only receipts, the overlap dispatcher and replay reuse it, so one change makes every runtime producer agree (design §2.3).
Notion operations arrive via NotionGatewaySDK(role:).catalog, so only a test and docs are added (design §1.4).
Missing previous occurrence omits both keys instead of writing a sentinel (design §2.1).
intentionalTradeoffs: Receipts written before this change lack the new keys and events replay reuses them verbatim (no backfill).
Existing routine binding files pick up the new template keys only when the routine is next created or updated (no migration).
The swift-webauthn pin style changes from exact to revision per owner direction.
c5pt-02 brute-force equivalence test may take tens of seconds in a debug build (low review finding).
supportedEdgeCases: America/New_York spring-forward: nonexistent local time has no occurrence (hourly and daily 02:30 cases).
Sparse Feb 29 schedule and impossible 31 Feb schedule returning nil within the horizon.
dom/dow OR rule when both day fields are restricted.
Fractional before instants (largest whole second strictly before).
Coalesced catch-up ticks each get their own schedule-derived previous value.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Backfilling previous-tick keys into historical receipts.
Updating the untracked riela-event-sources skill doc (text delta recorded in design §2.5).
Upstream gateway/kaiba API diffs not readable at plan time; handled by c5pt-01 tasks 3-4 and blocker rules.
